Our style guide requires typographic (curly) quotation marks in published prose. In NOTES.md, change only the tagline line so it reads exactly:

Tagline: “Fast” and ‘simple’

Use the curly characters “ ” ‘ ’ (U+201C, U+201D, U+2018, U+2019), not straight quotes. Do not change any other line.

rawInput.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='NOTES.md'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
old='Tagline: "Fast" and \'simple\''
new='Tagline: \u201cFast\u201d and \u2018simple\u2019'
assert old in s, "old line not found"
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
EOF
sed -n '3p' NOTES.md | od -An -tx1 -c
